6. INSTALL BOOT, FORK AND RELEASE BEARING TO

7. INSTALL TRANSMISSION
(See page MT-6)

(7M-GTE)
1. INSTALL RELEASE BEARING HUB ASSEMBLY TO CLUTCH
COVER

(a) Apply MP grease to the release bearing contact
surface.

(b) Install the plate washer, wave washer and bearing hub
assembly.

(c) Using a screwdriver, install the snap ring.

HINT: Support the release bearing under with a spacer
or such to raise the bearing hub assembly.

2. INSTALL TRANSMISSION WITH CLUTCH COVER AND
DISC
(See page MT-6)
